about_the_game: This is the Steam page for Dialtown: Phone Dating Sim's second DLC Soundtrack featuring Randy and Oliver as the main focus, composed by Nathan Hanover. The soundtrack contains every new track used within the Dialtown DLC, encompassing 9 total tracks! The OST contains just over half an hour of original music.
